thread:
maya: Heads-up: doing a quick link + examples audit for the Dedicated capacity docs. Found a couple of terraform/terragrunt gaps and an SDK snippet mismatch. Will open a PR in ~30m. Input welcome :eyes:

alex: Thanks — can you call out which pages? I can help with the autoscale policy examples.

maya: Pages: /dedicated/provisioning, /dedicated/autoscaling, /dedicated/sla, /dedicated/isolation. Main issues: terraform sample uses old resource names, terragrunt example is missing provider block, SDK Python snippet uses deprecated param 'pool_config' instead of 'capacity_config'.

ivan: If you're changing Terraform examples, include an HCL snippet for assigning labels to GPU pools. Ops legal asks for clearer SLA wording on eviction windows.

olivia: I'll proof the SLA wording. We should avoid 'best effort' — customers read that as 'no guarantees'. Suggest: 'SLA covers availability of reserved throughput; eviction behavior documented under isolation policy.'

docs-bot: new-pr: #8423 opened by maya - 'docs: dedicated link audit + infra snippets' https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8423

maya: PR contains: updated terraform + terragrunt, python + ts SDK snippets, a short migration guide from v1 schema to v2. Pinged @eng-runtime for kernel naming note.

alex: Quick ask: can we add an autoscale JSON example showing min_replicas, max_replicas, cpu_scale_threshold and a recommended profile for bursty chat workloads? I can paste one.

maya: Yes please. Prefer a compact example. Also add a note about prefix caching impact on autoscale thresholds.

alex: ```
{
  "autoscale_policy": {
    "min_replicas": 2,
    "max_replicas": 20,
    "scale_metric": "inflight_requests_per_gpu",
    "target": 40
  },
  "workload_profile": "chat-bursty"
}
```

ivan: LGTM for HCL/terragrunt changes. One small comment on provider alias usage. I'll leave inline review.

olivia: SLA wording suggestion in PR comment. Also added a short line recommending customers pin model versions to avoid silent regressions.

maya: Thanks. Also added a migration checklist at bottom of provisioning doc: backup configs, update terraform provider to >=0.12, run `terraform plan` and inspect autoscale resource diffs.

alex: Can we add a quick Typescript SDK example? Something like:
```js
const r = new Redwood({apiKey: process.env.RW_API});
await r.dedicated.createCapacity({region: 'us-west-2', capacity_config: {gpus: 4, gpu_type: 'a100'}});
```

maya: Added TS snippet and noted param name change from pool_config -> capacity_config. Will merge after Ivan's infra signoff. Targeting EOD.

ivan: Left approval with one nit. Merge when green. :shipit:

olivia: :thumbsup:
